questions.question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in the active or passive voice.**

Celebrate the New Year with amazing offers.

options.text: The New Year should be celebrated with amazing offers.
Let the New Year be celebrated with amazing offers.
Amazing offers will be celebrate in the New Year.
The New Year will be celebrated with amazing offers.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**Let the New Year be celebrated with amazing offers**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is an **imperative sentence**. A **sentence that expresses a request, advice, or order** is called an **imperative sentence **(here,** an order**).
 
• An **imperative sentence in the passive voice** has the following form: **Let + object + be + past participle**.
 
• The three rules for converting imperative sentences from active voice into passive voice:
 
 
• The i**mperative sentence in the passive voice** always **starts with** the word '**Let**'.
 
• The word '**be**' is used as an **auxiliary** in the **passive voice**.
 
• In the **imperative sentences**, the **first form of the verb in the active voice** (here, **celebrate**) is changed into the **third form of the verb in the passive voice** (here, **celebrated**).

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• Active Voice में , एक वाक्य विषय पर जोर देता है, एक क्रिया करता है।
 
• Passive Voice में , एक वाक्य वाक्य की क्रिया या वस्तु पर जोर देता है।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य imperative sentence है। एक वाक्य जो अनुरोध, सलाह या आदेश व्यक्त करता है उसे imperative sentence (यहां, एक आदेश) कहा जाता है।
 
• Passive voice में एक imperative sentence का निम्न रूप है: Let + object + be + past participle.
 
• Imperative sentences को active voice से passive voice में बदलने के तीन नियम:
 
 
• Passive voice में imperative sentence हमेशा 'Let' शब्द से शुरू होता है।
 
• Passive voice में 'be' शब्द का प्रयोग **सहायक के रूप में** किया जाता है।
 
• Imperative sentences में, active voice में क्रिया का पहला रूप (यहां, celebrate) passive voice में क्रिया के तीसरे रूप में बदल जाता है (यहां, celebrated)।

 
 
 

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 है।

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

He said to his sister, “Please help me with my homework.”

options.text: His sister told him that he should help her with her homework.
His sister was asked by her brother that she should help him with his homework.

questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is a direct speech.
 
• The basic rules for changing or converting direct speech into indirect speech:​
 
 
• The commas, inverted commas are removed.
 
• 'Please' indicates a request and therefore, the **reporting verb** 'requested' should be used in place of 'please' and it **must be** **followed by an object**.
 
• **Requests** are usually **reported using** a **to-infinitive** (here, **to help**).
 
• The **first-person pronoun 'me'** becomes the **third-person pronoun 'him'** and the **first-person pronoun 'my'** becomes the **third-person pronoun 'his'**.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य direct speech है।
 
• Direct speech को indirect speech में बदलने के लिए बुनियादी नियम:
 
 
• Commas, inverted commas और exclamation mark हटा दिए जाते हैं।
 
• 'Please' एक अनुरोध को इंगित करता है और इसलिए, 'Please' के स्थान पर रिपोर्टिंग क्रिया 'requested' का उपयोग किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• Requests को आमतौर पर to-infinitive (यहां, to help) का उपयोग करके रिपोर्ट किया जाता है।
 
• First-person pronoun 'me', third-person pronoun 'him' बन जाता है और first-person pronoun 'my', third-person pronoun 'his' बन जाता है।

 
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 है।

questions.question: A man buys goods for Rs. 8,000. He sells 30% of those goods at a profit of 12% and 40% of the remaining goods at a profit of 25%. At what profit percentage should he sell the remaining goods to gain 30% in the entire transaction (correct to one decimal place)?

Cost price of goods = Rs. 8000

**Formula used:**

Profit = SP – CP

Profit% = Profit/CP × 100

According to the question

30%of goods = (8000 × 30/100)

⇒ Rs. 2400

Profit = 12%

SP = (2400 × 112/100)

⇒ Rs. 2688

CP of 40% of remaining goods = (8000 – 2400) = Rs. 5600

⇒ (5600 × 40/100)

⇒ Rs. 2240

Profit = 25%

SP = (2240 × 125/100)

⇒ Rs. 2800

⇒ Rs. 10400

⇒ Rs. 1552

**∴ Required profit percentage is 46.2%**

questions.question: Which of the following is the full form of ASCII?

options.text: American Standard Code for Information Interchange
Analytical Scientific Code for Information Interchange
Asian Standard Code for Information Interchange
Analytical Standard Code for Intermitted Information

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**American Standard Code for Information Interchange.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ASCII stands for **American Standard Code for Information Interchange.**__
 
• It's a standard data-transmission code used by smaller and less powerful computers to represent textual data (letters, numbers, and punctuation marks) as well as non-input-device commands (control characters).
 
• Like other coding systems, it turns data into **standardised digital formats** that let computers communicate with one another and process and store data more efficiently.
 
• The ASCII code was created for teletypewriters but has now found widespread use in personal computers.
 
• Seven-digit binary integers, or numbers made up of multiple sequences of** 0s and 1s**, are used in the standard ASCII coding.
 
• Because there are 128 different possible combinations of seven 0s and 1s, the code can represent **128 different characters.**
 
• A lowercase "p" is represented by the binary sequence 1110000, while an uppercase "P" is represented by the binary sequence 1010000.
 
• The seven information bits plus a **parity bit **(used for error-checking purposes or to represent special symbols) in ASCII code are usually placed in an eight-bit field.

questions.solution:

• The polity of a country is designed according to its **Constitution**__ and any change to the polity is possible only when an amendment is made.
 
• The Indian Constitution can be amended to meet the **changing demands of the country.**
 
• A constitution that can be very easily changed or amended is often called **flexible.**
 
• A constitution that is very difficult to amend is described as** rigid.**
 
• The Indian Constitution** combines both flexible and rigid characteristics.**
 
• When an amendment seeks to change an article relating to the** allocation of powers between the states and the federal government**, or an article relating to the representation, the States must be contacted and consented to.

• In 1993, the newly formed Russian Federation adopted a new constitution as a result of this political upheaval.
